Only items with a physical stock entry as of report end date are included in Actual Cost unless the Stock Master configuration treats missing physical entries as zero. Formula chart: Ideal Cost = Wastage Cost + Recipe Consumption Cost; Ideal percent = Ideal Cost / (Total Sale + Stock Sale Cost + Indent Sale Cost) * 100; Actual Cost = (Opening + Stock In - Wastage Cost - Recipe Consumption Cost - StockOut) - Physical; Actual percent = Actual Cost / (Total Sale + Stock Sale Cost + Indent Sale Cost) * 100. The supplied header view ends after Sale and one Actual Cost child label is not visible, so the report remains partial.
